history.summary: A freehold D13 1BR (2009) near Woodleigh/Bidadari asking $1,654 PSF — bang on the $1,523 median (roughly +8.5%) — with the batch's highest URA rate at 5.84%/yr, though on a thin 18 transactions. Bidadari estate maturation is a real catalyst, but a weak 77-199 arena record and 820m MRT walk balance it to Neutral.
history.rating_rationale: Headline 5.84%/yr appreciation is the strongest in the batch and resale-only, but rests on only 18 transactions, so reliability is modest. Asking $1,654 vs $1,523 median is about +8.5% — a premium that eats into the appreciation edge. Freehold and a $1.05M entry are liquid. The poor arena record (77-199-39, Elo 993) and 820m walk to NE11 Woodleigh temper it. Bidadari's ongoing transformation is a genuine upside driver. Net Neutral.
red_flags: 5.84% rate rests on only 18 transactions — low reliability
catalysts: highest URA appreciation in batch (5.84%/yr, resale-only)
